preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The number of rooms in each test case is between 2 and 300000, inclusive.
The string s representing the conveyor belt states has the same length as the number of rooms n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '<>-' for c in s)
preconditions.description: Each character in the string s is one of '<', '>', or '-'.

postconditions.description: The number of returnable rooms is between 1 and n, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: result == sum(1 for i in range(n) if is_returnable(i, s, n))
postconditions.description: The result is the sum of returnable rooms for each test case.
